example: Illustrative example · fictional details · no real actions
distributionTitle: ONE LINK. MANY WAYS TO RECEIVE BOOKINGS.
distributionBody: Your public profile and enquiry form, where people already find you. Promoters can send a request without creating an account.
channels: Link your profile in your bio or share it in direct messages.
Configure the link in greeting, away or prepared messages.
Embed the booking widget or link directly to the form.
Put your profile on posters, EPKs and other physical or digital materials.
Share it by email, message or any other channel.
manual: Instagram and WhatsApp are not automatically connected. You configure and share the link on each platform.
linkExample: Example link structure; this is not a published profile.
journeyBody: One opportunity keeps its conversation, terms and next action together. A hold is not a confirmation.
stepBodies: The promoter submits details from your public profile.
Review the contact, date and proposal before proceeding.
Record messages and agreements in the same booking.
Mark provisional availability and its expiry.
Confirm the terms once the decision is agreed.
Check dates and distinguish holds from confirmations.
emailTitle: AN OFFER ARRIVES. CUEBOOKER PUTS IT IN ORDER.
emailBody: Cuebooker detects possible booking offers in an authorised inbox and prepares a request from the available details. You review and decide.
emailStages: Distinguishes possible booking offers from unrelated messages.
Captures contact, artist, date, venue and terms when mentioned.
Prepares a request using available information so you can check it and decide the next step.
emailNote: Private beta with authorised activation. The attachments in this demonstration illustrate a feature in development, not yet confirmed in production.
ecosystem: Your professional introduction and entry point for requests.
A career connected to real booking activity.
Your own visual identity within the Cuebooker universe.
rosterBody: Artists, requests and dates in one operation. Keep the relevant artist context without multiplying an agency proposal.
contextBody: An enquiry addressed to the agency retains its contact and conversation. Assign the relevant artist in that same context; it does not become a separate copy for every artist.
context: Review the proposal and reply to the contact
